Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Declaration This enquiry is being issued to “M/s Ladies Club BHEL Haridwar” Uttarakha nd” on single tender basis through GeM portal for supply of “Grocery Items” to BHEL Haridwar Guest houses (Trishul, Neelgiri, Shivalik). Since it is a single tend er enquiry issued to the above supplier, hence No other supplier’s participation sha ll be considered. In view of this, it is requested to please do not participate in this t ender enquiry, except aforesaid supplier/authorized dealer. In case any other bidd er participates, their offer shall be rejected. On behalf of BHEL Haridwar, Uttarakhand-249403 Scope of Work/Tender specific Terms and condition Item description: Grocery Items (Cereals, pulses. and misc.) Department: Guests houses (Trishul, Neelgiri and Shivalik) , BHEL Harid war. 1. All Techno commercial terms and condition as per enclosed memorandum of understanding (MOU: H EEP/MM/MOU/04-Ladies Club dated 28.10.2026) between BHEL and ladies club shall be applicabl e. 2. Offer will be accepted only from BHEL Ladies Club, Haridwar. (As per MoU No. HEEP/MM/MOU/04-L adies Club dated 28.10.2026) 3. Grocery Items/Goods must be of supplied of good quality/AGMARK only. 4. Technical Terms & conditions a. Prices/Basis of Quotation i. Goods rates shall be quoted through GeM on FOR destination basis, incl usive of GST as applicable. ii. The offered prices of the items shall remain firm and fixed till the execu tion of the contract. iii. GeM charges if any shall be either side only i.e. buyer’s GeM charges sh all be in buyer’s account and seller’s GeM charges shall be on seller’s accou nt. 5. Bidder is advised to read GeM related query & clarification carefully. Order shall be executed through GeM as per scope of work. 6. Validity of offer/bid: a. Validity of the offer shall be 90 days from the date opening of Techno-Comm ercial bid (Part-I bid). Offer of bidder’s having validity less than 90 days shall li able to be reject.

7. Following documents are an integral part of this Tender Enquiry and endorsed co pies of these documents (duly signed and stamped on each page, as a token of ac ceptance) are to be submitted/uploaded along with offer on GeM portal against th is bid. a. Scope of work b. Please submit replica of Price schedule (without prices) showing ‘’quoted” in place of price along with techno-commercial bid (Part-I). c. Signed & Stamped copy (each page) of tender conditions/scope of works. d. Valid FSSAI certificate, as applicable. e. MII- Please submit certificate of Minimum local content as specified in the Ma ke in India Certificate of the tender. As applicable. f. MSE certificate, if any g. No Deviation certificate. 8. Evaluation criteria of offer/Bid: a. Evaluation of offer shall be done on total landed cost basis to BHEL. The eval uation currency shall be INR. BHEL Haridwar may reject the techno-commerci al offer based on the evaluation in case of not fulfilling BHEL requirement as p er scope of work/tender T&C. b. In case of any deviation taken be vendor in any condition, vendor to submit t he same along with Part-I bid in separate sheets with proper justificatory for B HEL review. BHEL may accept or reject the deviations sought by the bidder(s). Based upon the evaluation, BHEL reserves the right to reject the bidder witho ut assigning reason for the same. 9. If the quality of goods is found not up to the mark, the rejected quantity will hav e to be replaced within immediately. The quantity of items can be increased or de creased as per requirement. 10. BHEL will have full right to cancel the above work without assigning any reason. 11. FSSAI Certificate must be submitted with Technical bid (Part-I), if applicable. 12. If required, sample shall be provided at the time of technical evaluation to BHEL guest house office or BHEL representative will visit to witness sampling at vendor shop/works. 13. The discount if offered by contractor on Bid Price shall be applicable throughout the tenure of contract. Hence, being a regular supplier to BHEL, best possible/neg otiated rates shall be quoted on GeM. 14. Contract period shall be applicable for one year from the date of PO/contract or as per PO delivery schedule of items, whichever is later. 15. The Contractor shall not assign or sublet or subcontract this purchase order or a ny part thereof to any third party in any circumstances. BHEL will directly deal wit h the Main supplier. 16. GeM GTC 4.0 (Version 1.29), dated 25th March 2026 or its latest revision o

f GeM portal shall be applicable and mandatory to comply it. Detailed a latest Ge M GTC is available on GeM portal. 17. Make in India clause: "For this procurement, the local content to categorize a su pplier as a Class I local supplier/ Class II local Supplier/ Non-local supplier and pur chase preference to Class I local supplier, is as defined in Public Procurement (Pref erence to Make in India), Order 2017 dated 19.07.2024 issued by DPIIT. In case of subsequent orders issued by the nodal ministry, changing the definition of local co ntent for the items of the NIT, the same shall be applicable even if issued after iss ue of this NIT, but before opening of Part-II bids against this NIT".As per Make in In dia Order, only Class-1 and Class-2 local supplies are eligible to bid in this tender enquiry (For this eligibility criteria, bidders are required to submit certificate of Minimum local content as specified in attached Make In Ind ia Declaration format, as applicable). 18. MSE criteria: vendor to submit and upload the valid MSE certificate along with Pa rt-1 offer/bid, if any. 19. Compliance of Rule 144 (xi) of GFR 2017: Compliance of Restrictions under Rule 144 (xi) of GFR 2017 shall be as per GeM. 20. Order Acceptance: Ink signed order acceptance shall be furnished within 15 days of order placement. In case, order acceptance not received within 15 days of orde r placement, PO deemed to be accepted by you. 21. Breach of contract/EMD/Risk purchase/LD/- Waive off as per MOU- HEEP/MM/MOU/04-Ladies Club dated 28.10.2026 Part-B. 22. Suspension of Business Dealings with Suppliers /Contractors: The offers of the bidders who are under suspension as also the offers of the bidders, who en gage the services of the banned firms / principal / agents, shall be rejected. The li st of banned firms is available on BHEL web site www.bhel.com.If any bidder / sup plier / contractor during pre-tendering / tendering / post tendering / award / execu tion / post-execution stage indulges in any act, including but not limited to, mal-pr actices, cheating, bribery, fraud or and other misconduct or formation of cartel so as to influence the bidding process or influence the price or tampers the tenderin g process or acts or omits in any manner which tantamount to an offence punisha ble under any provision of the Indian Penal Code, 1860( Bhartiya Nyaya Samhita 2 023) or any other law in force in India, or does anything which is actionable under the Guidelines for Suspension of Business dealings, action may be taken against s uch bidder / supplier / contractor as per extant guidelines of the company availabl e on www.bhel.com and / or under applicable legal provisions. Guidelines for susp ension of business dealings is available in the webpage: http://www.bhel.com/vender_registration/vender.php. 23. ARBITRATION Clause If any dispute or difference of any kind whatsoever shall arise between BHEL and the Supplier/Vendor, arising out of the contract for the pe rformance of the work whether during the progress of contract termination, aband onment or breach of the contract, it shall in the first place referred to Designated Officer / IEM for amicable resolution by the parties. Designated Officer / IEM who within 60 days after being requested shall give written notice of his decision to th e contractor. Save as hereinafter provided, such decision in respect of every matt er so referred shall forthwith be given effect to by the Supplier/Vendor who shall p roceed with the work with all due diligence, whether he or BHEL desires to resolve the dispute as hereinafter provided or not. If after the Designated Engineer has gi

ven written notice of this decision to the party and no intention to pursue the disp ute has been communicated to him by the affected party within 30 days from the receipt of such notice, the said decision shall become final and binding on the par ties. In the event the Supplier/Vendor being dissatisfied with any such decision or if amicable settlement cannot be reached then all such disputed issues shall be re solved through conciliation in terms of the BHEL Conciliation Scheme 2018 as per ‘CONCILIATION’ Clause. JURISDICTION: This contract shall be governed by the Law for the time being in f orce in the Republic of India. Subject to clause(s) mentioned above of this contrac t, the Civil Court having original Civil Jurisdiction at Haridwar shall alone have excl usive jurisdiction in regard to all matters in respect of the Contract. Commercial Terms & Conditions 24. Delivery term: a. Contractor to deliver/supply all grocery items of good quality to different Gue st Houses as per day to day requirement on FOR basis in good packed conditi on. b. Daily requirement of Guest houses shall be intimated one day in advance by the respective stores In-charge of guest houses and also will be intimated for the immediate delivery as per emergency requirements of guest house. Vend or has to deliver the items accordingly. c. If the supplied grocery items are found less than standard by any means, the n the supply of grocery items shall be rejected. And grocery items will be proc ured from local market on urgency basis. The difference of amount shall be b orne by the supplier and shall be deducted from the bill of the supplier. The a mount of rejected quantity will also be deducted from the bill of the supplier. 25. Submission of bill: a. Vendor shall submit the bill for payment monthly basis. However, vendor to provide the challan against each delivery of items to the respective guest hou se /store in charge. Also, shall keep the proper record of challan date wise aga inst the bill submitted to BHEL. Actual bill of quantity/supply of quantity shall be inline of the vendor invoice and GeM invoice. b. 3 Sets of original complete billing documents (hard copy) shall be submitted to BHEL (immediately or within 1st week of every month). 26. Payment term: a. Payment term is applicable as per signed MOU (As per MoU No. HEEP/MM/M OU/04-Ladies Club, Part B dated 28.10.2026) between BHEL and ladies club i. e. in 15 days from the date of acceptance of material.

b. Vendor to create the GeM invoice through GeM portal on time, so that CRAC as a certificate of acceptance of item can be generated timely by BHEL for pro cessing of vendor bill for payment as per MOU timeline. 27. Prices shall be firm till execution of the contract.
